---
name: database
description: Work safely with relational databases, queries, schema changes, migrations, data fixes, and persistence logic.
---

# Database Skill

- Inspect the current schema and persistence patterns first.
- Use parameterized queries.
- Consider indexes and query performance.
- Preserve data integrity and constraints.
- Make migrations reversible when practical.
- Consider existing production data before schema changes.
- Avoid destructive operations unless explicitly requested.
- For data fixes, define scope and verification steps.
- Add or update tests where persistence behavior changes.
